00-demo-sites.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12), demo only: four invented competitor websites that change from week 1 to 4, plus an admin link to set the week.

01-run-checks.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): every 6 hours checks each watched page, has GPT-5.4 rate and explain the changes, saves them and emails alerts.

02-check-page.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): fetches and cleans one page, fingerprints it, reads products (JSON-LD or GPT-5.4 mini) and lists what changed.

03-dashboard.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): the team dashboard (change feed, price position, history charts, page health) and its actions.

04-weekly-digest.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): Monday 8:00 email with the week's changes by importance, price position and page problems.

05-save-changes.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): writes a plan to Google Sheets (changes, prices, runs, matches, pages) and sends emails (Gmail live, Outbox in test).

06-reset-demo.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): resets the sheet (settings, our bikes, watchlist, matches) and the demo competitor sites to week 1.

07-create-sheet.ts.description: Competitor radar (project 12): run once to create the Google Sheet the radar runs on.
